title: goldfussia paniculata var. alata
intro: Goldfussia paniculata var. alata, commonly known as Alata Goldfussia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is native to tropical regions and is prized for its attractive foliage and fragrant flowers, which are used in traditional medicine. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, headache, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and promoting relaxation. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
